Merion Village Condo | $318,000
1120 S 3rd St Unit 12, Columbus, OH 43206
2 bed 2 bath, 1,050 sq ft, built 2008. HOA dues $570 every quarter. Real estate taxes $1,850 for the half-year. Homeowners insurance $860 a year. Seller credit of 2% toward closing costs. Closing costs $5,500 plus $900 additional for the survey. Buyer pays a $400 document fee, a $750 capital contribution and a $300 move-in deposit to the association at closing. Special assessment $150 a month through June 2028, buyer pays. Earnest money $3,000. Inspection 10 days.
